name: code-analysis
description: Code analysis skills for documenting representative end-to-end implementation workflows and reusable blueprints.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze codebase workflows and generate implementation blueprints.
interface.longDescription: Code Analysis packages GitHub's awesome-copilot project-workflow-analysis-blueprint-generator skill as a Codex skill. It helps agents inspect a codebase, identify representative end-to-end workflows, and produce implementation-ready blueprints covering entry points, service layers, data mapping, data access, error handling, testing patterns, sequence diagrams, naming conventions, and reusable implementation templates.
defaultPrompt: Use Code Analysis to document representative workflows in this codebase.
Generate an implementation blueprint for this project workflow.
Analyze entry points, services, data access, errors, and tests here.
